scripts.deploy:api: docker compose --env-file docker-compose.shared.env --env-file docker-compose.api.env --env-file docker-compose.cloudflared.env up -d --build --wait --wait-timeout 60 api cloudflared && echo '✓ API + tunnel deployed' && (docker compose --env-file docker-compose.shared.env --env-file docker-compose.api.env --env-file docker-compose.cloudflared.env logs --tail=10 --follow=false api cloudflared || true)
scripts.api:logs: docker compose --env-file docker-compose.shared.env --env-file docker-compose.api.env --env-file docker-compose.cloudflared.env logs -f --tail=100 api
scripts.api:stop: docker compose --env-file docker-compose.shared.env --env-file docker-compose.api.env --env-file docker-compose.cloudflared.env stop api
scripts.tunnel:logs: docker compose --env-file docker-compose.shared.env --env-file docker-compose.api.env --env-file docker-compose.cloudflared.env logs -f --tail=100 cloudflared
scripts.tunnel:stop: docker compose --env-file docker-compose.shared.env --env-file docker-compose.api.env --env-file docker-compose.cloudflared.env stop cloudflared
scripts.worker:deploy: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.worker.yml --env-file docker-compose.shared.env --env-file docker-compose.worker.env up -d --build worker
scripts.worker:logs: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.worker.yml --env-file docker-compose.shared.env --env-file docker-compose.worker.env logs -f --tail=100 worker
scripts.worker:stop: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.worker.yml --env-file docker-compose.shared.env --env-file docker-compose.worker.env stop worker
